protocol.budget_matching: Per case and per split, identical prefix counts from the source audit; no outcome-based filtering.
protocol.estimator: Equal-weight case mean; require both arms to be non-missing for each contrast.
protocol.multi_fact_subset: 352 cases with more than one annotated supporting fact; not a strict cross-chunk-necessity test.
protocol.missing: Six vanilla support-recall values are missing; recall contrasts use 994 paired cases. Missing is never zero.
protocol.semantic_correctness: Not assessed by these dataset metrics.
protocol.timing: Context characters are an evidence-footprint measurement, not wall-clock time or GPU memory.
